title: IntentFrame
description: Decoded user intent at one instant. The ONLY input gameplay logic receives from the body. Continuous fields are 0..1 activation levels; booleans are not used so decoders can express graded intent.

seq.description: Monotonic frame counter per decoder run; gaps = dropped frames.

timestamp.description: LSL clock (pylsl.local_clock) seconds at decode time.

walk_forward.description: Locomotion drive. V1: derived from alternating leg step-intent cadence (v = k * f_step).

action_strength.description: Generic intensity of the current action (e.g. swing force).

core_activation.description: Synthetic physiology (V2+). C = (EMG - mu_rest) / (mu_max - mu_rest), clipped to [0,1].

respiration_phase.description: Optional: -1 full exhale .. +1 full inhale, from a respiration sensor.

stillness.description: 1 = body at rest; used by the mana 'Sense' stage.

gaze_target.description: Id of the object the user is looking at, if known (Phase 6 fusion).

extra.description: Experiment-specific channels not yet promoted to first-class fields. Promote a field once two experiments use it.
